workflow.description:
With this process, a sales order is automatically approved if one of the following is true:
- The total amount of the sales order is $0.00 US dollars or - The creator does not have a supervisor.
If the sales order is not automatically approved, a manual approval process begins. An approver can edit, approve, reject, or cancel the sales order. If the sales order is rejected, the creator may cancel it or edit it and resubmit it for approval. After the sales order is approved, it is locked to all users except those with the Administrators role.
workflow.name: $0 Sales Order Approval

sendemailaction.body: Sales Order {TRANID} at $0.00 has just been created and needs approval.
sendemailaction.subject: SO {TRANID} needs your attention

sendemailaction.body: A Workflow has resulted in a $0.00 Sales Order approval. This is your requested notification. See attached transaction for details.
sendemailaction.subject: Workflow Result: $0.00 Sales Order Approved

sendemailaction.body: Your order has been approved and is ready for fulfillment scheduling.
sendemailaction.subject: Workflow Result: Approved

sendemailaction.body: Your Sales Order {TRANID} has been rejected.
sendemailaction.subject: SO {TRANID} rejected

initcondition.formula: "Workflow:Created By" NOT IN ("User") AND "User Role" NOT IN ("Role1","Role2","Role3","Role4","Role5","Role6")
